name: node-cli
description: Node CLI using commander, installable via npm bin.

files.content:
#!/usr/bin/env node
import { program } from 'commander'
program.name('greet').argument('<name>').option('-l, --loud','shout it')
  .action((name,o)=> console.log(o.loud ? `HI ${name.toUpperCase()}!` : `hi ${name}`))
program.parse()
